a: The remedies are highly diluted flower essences preserved in brandy, so a small amount of alcohol is present. Many people of different ages use them. If you are pregnant, avoid alcohol, are choosing for a child, or have a health condition, please check with your doctor first.

q: How long before I notice a difference?
a: Experiences vary and results are not guaranteed. Some people notice a change early on; for deeper emotional patterns, many continue for 4–6 weeks. A follow-up consultation helps refine the blend.
In a session we talk through your current emotional state — what you feel, when, and how it affects daily life. The blend is then personalised to you.

q: Can I take them alongside medication?
a: Bach Flower Remedies are complementary and are not a substitute for medical care. Please keep taking any prescribed medicine, and mention the remedies to your doctor.
